verdict.rationale: Open WebUI is an AI assistant and agent-host platform, which puts it in the MCP client role. The evidence shows it can call tools exposed by external MCP servers, but that is client-side capability and does not count for this server axis. Nothing in the pack shows Open WebUI running as an MCP server itself, such as an mcp serve mode or a hosted MCP endpoint. Its OpenAI-compatible gateway is not an MCP server.
